summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's advertised functionality is a trivial default export (`export default 'John'` in lib/index.js), but package.json declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and proxy-object string indirection) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime binary for the installer's platform/arch from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, chmods it executable in a temp directory, and uses `execFileSync` to run the sibling `math_init.js` under that freshly-downloaded runtime. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled CJS module (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) implemented as a rotated string-array VM (numeric token array, rotator function, 90-character permutation-alphabet decoder) with randomized identifiers and no documentation in README or CHANGELOG. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on every `npm install` under an alternate runtime chosen specifically to avoid the Node.js execution environment. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time execution of opaque attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine, with the loader itself obfuscated to frustrate review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
